title: Counter decrement exit routing
statement: Given a state set $S$, a distinguished state $a\in S$, and a flag phase, map the completed phase with flag true to the body state carrying $a$, and the completed phase with flag false to the done state. Map every other phase to the decrement state carrying that phase.
